src/cli/print.ts is the single worst function in the codebase: 3,167 lines long, 12 levels of nesting, ~486 branch points of cyclomatic complexity, 12 parameters plus an options object with 16 sub-properties. Should be at minimum 8–10 separate modules.

NEVER include in commit messages or PR descriptions: The phrase 'Claude Code' or any mention that you are an AI; Co-Authored-By lines or any other attribution. This very much sounds like it stays undercover and pretends to be a human, even for public repo contributions.
